text:
sarah: Quick share — ran a 6h continuous-batcher sweep across APAC/EU/US on mosaic-13b q4_int8 to test window robustness + fairness. High-level: APAC H100 pool sees p99 spikes when window_ms <= 25 under mixed-priority traffic. Charts + raw logs uploaded.
raj: link? saw a throughput drop in yesterday's run.
emily: did you repro with kernel_switcher off? that caused regressions for us last quarter.
sarah: yes — compared kernel_switcher=on vs off. With switcher=on EU/US tail improves but APAC p99 worsens. p50 numbers: US 12ms, EU 14ms, APAC 20ms. steady throughput (tok/s): US 1.25k, EU 1.05k, APAC 0.88k. full charts: https://redwood.internal/bench/2129001000
kai: paste the run command please
sarah: `python bench.py --model mosaic-13b --quant q4_int8 --window_ms 20 --max_batch_tokens 4096 --kernel_switcher on --region apac --cohort-profile mixed-priority`
dan: any per-cohort fairness metrics? starvation for small tenants?
sarah: added cohort fairness metric. Most cohorts >80% serve_rate, but APAC had ~7% cohorts under 50% when window_ms < 20. Root cause looks like early coalescing bias + KV cache eviction on long-tail sequences.

log snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T03:12:05Z] COHORT 73: served=42/100, queued=58
[2026-03-18T03:12:05Z] KV_CACHE EVICT triggered=11, retained=1223
[2026-03-18T03:12:05Z] KERNEL_TAG=nvfuser_v2, batch_tokens=384, latency=214ms
```

perf-bot: auto-notice — regression vs baseline 2110000000: APAC p99 +28% (p<0.01). See /bench/alerts/2129001000
jen: OK, proposed mitigations?
sarah: plan: 1) widen default continuous-batcher window to 30ms for APAC H100 pool, 2) add per-region kernel_affinity flag to prefer aten kernels in APAC, 3) run targeted kernel sweep (nvfuser vs aten) for q4_int8 with varied max_batch_tokens and window_ms. I'll open a PR with config diffs and schedule overnight sweep.
raj: ack — assign eng-runtime + eng-ml. i'll own the kernel sweep and compare nvfuser_v2 / aten_xnn / aten_default.
deploy-bot: scheduled job 2129001200: kernel-sweep-apac-overnight (expected duration 8h)
sarah: thanks all — will post updated charts and a short writeup after the overnight run :thumbsup:
